<!-- what changed and why. Link an issue if there is one (Closes #123)
     The preferred merges are a single or contained change with tests already run and passed. Larger changes or skipped tests may still be accepted if justified, but can lead to slower merges -->

## Testing
<!-- tick what applies -->
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes locally (API changes)
- [ ] `npm run test:web` passes locally (web player changes)
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a test
- [ ] Ran in Docker (`npm run cpu:up` / `gpu:up`), for inference or docker changes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry, if users will notice the change
